content: मूर्च्छा [मुर्च्छ्-भावे अङ्] .²1 Fainting, swooning; प्रहारमूर्च्छापगमे <ls>R. 7. 44</ls>. .²2 Spiritual ignorance or delusion. .²3 A process in calcining metals; मूर्च्छां गतो मृतो वा निदर्शनं पारदोऽत्र रसः <ls>Bv. 1. 82</ls>. .²4 The rising of sounds <ab>&c.</ab>; see मूर्च्छन (4) above. .²5 Growth, increase.
